title: External Hydrology and Crop Exchange Contract Architecture
qualification_scope: candidate ownership-safe hydrology and external crop exchange frames, interval/result semantics, coupled reject/commit barrier, compatibility identity and source-bound field coverage; no production adapter or canonical exchange admission
architecture_decisions: exchange ownership observation interval forcing and transaction control are separate concepts
ANIMO consumes immutable hydrology and external crop frames rather than pointers to foreign mutable state
hydrology exchange contains both endpoint water coordinates and interval-integrated water transfers because neither alone is generally sufficient for transport and conservation
chemical composition of irrigation runon deposition and bottom inflow is a forcing/material concern and is not hidden inside the hydrology adapter
external crop mode never allocates duplicate ANIMO persistent crop state
realized crop nutrient uptake crosses the boundary as an ANIMO trial result linked to typed physical transfer events
external crop residues exudates harvest and grazing semantics must be explicit event bundles and are not inferred from crop state differences
one coupled trial binds exact accepted generations producer frame ids interval identity geometry and physical layout identity
coupled accept has a logical commit barrier while reject preserves every participant accepted physical generation
frame mutation under an existing identity is forbidden and retry receives a new trial binding
ANIMO checkpoints retain compatibility references but do not serialize externally owned hydrology or external crop physical state
macropore exchange fields are defined only as a blocked extension contract under TCD-025
ARCH05 defines no orchestration convergence rule timestep acceptance criterion numerical tolerance production ABI or unit-conversion implementation
source_bound_evidence_used: PREP06 water storage and transfer ledger including vertical flow drainage infiltration bottom exchange runoff runon and interception
PREP06 crop N and P uptake identities
PREP06 crop residue harvest and grazing control-volume identities
remaining_blockers: MIGRATION_DAG still requires qualified migration baseline QM before canonical STATE and downstream exchange admission
PREP02 historical or independently trusted reference environment remains unresolved
controlled immutable B0 retention remains a separate governance gate
generic TIME acceptance retry substep and coupled convergence semantics remain unqualified
no production SWAP hydrology adapter exists
no production WOFOST or other external crop adapter exists
no behavioural coupled rollback or split-run equivalence evidence exists
unit conversion and precision implementations are not qualified
GHG theory-ledger reconciliation remains incomplete outside this exchange scope
supplied testbank has no active macropore case and TCD-025 blocks macropore admission

parallel_now: define a candidate normalized model-configuration and identity manifest producing feature_set_id physical_layout_id configuration_identity and exchange-schema bindings without production implementation
derive adapter qualification test specifications for hydrology and external crop frames using exact field and transaction contracts
prepare execution-class grouping rules based on immutable physical layout identity without changing physics
continue PREP02 reference recovery and controlled B0 retention independently
serial_after_qm: qualify or revise candidate STATE ownership
qualify generic TIME and coupled transaction semantics
then qualify concrete exchange adapters and production coupling
